data.one_liner: A vertical scrollable tab bar widget for Flutter layouts.
data.what_it_does: Provides vertical scrollable tab bars and tab views for Flutter applications. It supports both controller-based usage and standalone widgets, allowing customizable layouts, alignments, and tab backgrounds.
use_when: You need a vertical tab layout instead of the traditional horizontal tab bar.
You want to display scrollable tabs with custom labels and content.
avoid_when: You only require standard horizontal tabs provided by Flutter's core Material library.
strengths: Supports both controller-based and controller-free implementations.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Offers tab bar alignment and background color customizations.
weaknesses: Limited to vertical tab layouts, which may not fit standard design requirements.
data.minimal_example:
ScrollableTab(
  labelColor: Colors.black,
  tabs: List.generate(
      5,
      (index) => Tab(
            text: 'index $index',
          )),
  children: List.generate(
      5,
      (index) => ListTile(
            title: Center(
              child: Text(
                'tab Number $index',
              ),
            ),
          )),
)
